frozen_protocol.hypothesis: Permit-status ambiguity recurs often enough that contractors already spend operator time on a manual workaround.
frozen_protocol.participant_segment: Small and midsize US commercial contractors that directly manage municipal permits
questions: Tell me about the last time a permit status was unclear or did not match what your team expected.
What did your team do to resolve it?
Roughly how often has that kind of follow-up happened in the last month?
What happens operationally if nobody follows up?
Who or what currently keeps track of those exceptions?

call_arguments.task: Call one authorized research participant on behalf of CounterSignal Research. Speak in locale en-US. Identify yourself as an AI research assistant and ask for consent to a short customer-discovery interview. Do not disclose the hypothesis, pitch, persuade, coach, sell, collect names, or request credentials, payment data, or personal contact details. If consent is not clearly yes, end the call without asking the research questions. First confirm the participant matches this segment: Small and midsize US commercial contractors that directly manage municipal permits. Then ask these exact pre-registered questions in order, without adding leading follow-ups: Question 1: Tell me about the last time a permit status was unclear or did not match what your team expected. Question 2: What did your team do to resolve it? Question 3: Roughly how often has that kind of follow-up happened in the last month? Question 4: What happens operationally if nobody follows up? Question 5: Who or what currently keeps track of those exceptions? Classify the evidence as confirmation only when the participant describes the hypothesized pain from their own experience; classify it as contradiction when their experience rejects the pain or already solves it; otherwise use ambiguous or no_response. Capture one short verbatim participant quote. The frozen hypothesis is: Permit-status ambiguity recurs often enough that contractors already spend operator time on a manual workaround. Do not claim product-market fit or change the frozen decision rule.
